cohort: 291 pregnant women with MRI-confirmed adenomyosis and a control group matched 4:1 for age, parity, and body mass index
finding: Adenomyosis diagnosed by MRI was associated with an increased risk of caesarean section, intrauterine growth restriction, postpartum haemorrhage, pre-eclampsia, and previous spontaneous miscarriage.
mod_finding: Women with MRI-confirmed adenomyosis had an increased risk of cesarean section compared to the control group.
gest_age: Pregnancies reaching at least 24 weeks of gestation
